trigger: Consume retained direct-source observation through Workspace-shaped matching
consequence: Unsupported qualified use or unsafe workaround
current_protection: G01 documented statically; independent source creation is deliberately not data-use authorization
minimum_prevention: Resolve BN-USE-01 issuer and exact use contract without automatic grants
discriminating_verification: Real source observation and operating grant command through actual Business consumer; reject mixed or foreign owner

trigger: Declare P1 or API-only consumer a completed advertiser service
consequence: Stored context without useful outcome or next action
current_protection: Existing bounded HTTP consumers and honest deferred navigation
minimum_prevention: Connect one qualified consumer to actual advertiser journey with actionable limits
discriminating_verification: Real component and browser journey from qualified context to result and feasible next action

trigger: Reuse business.context.read for every new field or history projection
consequence: Excess access for team or agency or internal staff
current_protection: Existing SQL rights and private history separation
minimum_prevention: Specify field operation audience and history authority through existing owners
discriminating_verification: Direct/internal team and foreign Business negative HTTP tests including history pagination

trigger: Reinterpret declared_markets as target/current/serviceability
consequence: Unsupported geography decision and changed historical meaning
current_protection: Versioned current declarations
minimum_prevention: Separate meanings as needed and require confirmation for changed semantics
discriminating_verification: Current sale versus intended expansion versus serviceable area; unchanged historical replay

affected_boundary: Offering context and specialist extension fitness
trigger: Use sector label or three D2 methods as universal commercial expertise
consequence: Wrong comparison unit or unsupported recommendation
current_protection: D2 finite methods and source limits are explicit
minimum_prevention: Qualify one consumer question and minimal offering facts; preserve accepted decision owner
discriminating_verification: Same sector different buying situation and different sector equivalent question; method abstains outside domain

trigger: Treat source-asserted inquiry or attributed conversion as payment or profit
consequence: Misleading ROI and harmful spend decision
current_protection: BF03 preserves assertion and criteria meaning
minimum_prevention: Use qualified outcome source and denominator period currency and maturity
discriminating_verification: Cheaper CPL with fewer qualified outcomes; delayed refund; unknown outcome remains unknown

trigger: Assume read adapters and local receipts imply campaign-write capability
consequence: Unauthorized or duplicated external effect
current_protection: Current architecture explicitly separates decision and execution
minimum_prevention: Define exact provider resource effect authority preconditions command and reconciliation
discriminating_verification: Lost reply after external success; stale resource or revoked right before dispatch; partial effect

trigger: Treat UNKNOWN or HOLD as unlimited paid AI usage
consequence: Unbounded cost or unsupported sales entitlement
current_protection: RegisterCommercialScope returns explicit HOLD and UNKNOWN
minimum_prevention: Admit the specific paid capability with bounded usage and payer policy
discriminating_verification: Denied or unknown entitlement cannot create paid use; independent local declaration still works

trigger: New consumer ignores scope revision or late response qualification
consequence: Old Business data displayed after context or identity change
current_protection: Transport revision abort and identity checks; query clear on document close
minimum_prevention: Reuse transport and include relevant qualified scope in cache keys; requalify presentation
discriminating_verification: Delayed A response after switching to B; identity change refresh new document and revocation

trigger: Treat timeout or aborted fetch as confirmed nonexecution
consequence: Duplicate command effect or lost original command
current_protection: Existing idempotent commands and recovery patterns
minimum_prevention: Distinguish confirmed 422 and 409 from unknown; reconcile original command
discriminating_verification: Actual component retries after confirmed rejection and no replacement after unknown response

affected_boundary: Final SQL definitions and migration upgrade
trigger: Later reload replaces shared function with incomplete definition
consequence: Lost authority branch or historical codec compatibility
current_protection: FinalSchemaCompositionTest covers fresh and populated historical upgrades
minimum_prevention: Extend final behavior tests and inspect reload owners and order; additive upgrade where required
discriminating_verification: Fresh and populated upgrade with unchanged receipts digests grants ciphertext and exact replay

trigger: External network call under locks or changed lock order
consequence: Long waits deadlocks or decision based on revoked evidence
current_protection: Existing fences and concurrency contracts
minimum_prevention: Keep transactions short; compute externally then requalify; preserve lock order
discriminating_verification: Observe real blockers and recheck rights after wait; no weaker isolation or longer timeout to pass

trigger: Introduce pooling or long-lived request state without compatibility proof
consequence: Cross-context state or invalid PID/XID ticket binding
current_protection: PrincipalContext checks clean owned transaction and binds ticket to backend/XID
minimum_prevention: Qualify roles transactions session features cleanup and authority side connection
discriminating_verification: Repeated A/B requests on same worker and reused server connection including exceptions; PID/XID and current role verification

affected_boundary: Queue retries leases fairness and provider rate
trigger: Timeout/visibility mismatch or shared unbounded retry lane
consequence: Duplicate work starvation or rate-limit storm
current_protection: ProviderQueuePolicy scoped lock; bounded deadlines; default Redis retry_after90 and Meta timeout60
minimum_prevention: Verify actual worker settings timeout lease retry and attempt limits per operation; honor provider retry semantics
discriminating_verification: Kill or redeliver worker under real pending work; queue depth and sibling isolation; no duplicate external effect

trigger: Assume after_commit alone guarantees durable handoff
consequence: Committed command never scheduled or dispatch repeated
current_protection: Existing receipts/recovery patterns require operation-specific evaluation
minimum_prevention: Reuse durable pending state and reconciliation; add scoped outbox only for proven delivery gap
discriminating_verification: Crash after commit before enqueue and after enqueue before acknowledgement; converge from persistent command

trigger: Large taxonomy or relationship expansion on current aggregation
consequence: Excess queries scans transfer size and client parsing
current_protection: Several current surfaces bound pages; catalog and selected aggregations need workload review
minimum_prevention: Measure actual SQL with runtime role and choose selective index pagination or cache by valid scope
discriminating_verification: Representative and skewed histories/catalog with query plans and payload; no inferred bottleneck

trigger: Increase concurrency work_mem or worker count without resource budget
consequence: OOM temp disk exhaustion or test interference
current_protection: Disposable test guard and bounded workers; live limits not inspected here
minimum_prevention: Record RAM shared memory disk temp active connections parallelism and workload before tuning
discriminating_verification: Memory plateau plus wait/temp/connection metrics under isolated representative concurrency; distinguish bootstrap from contention

trigger: Ship all sections data and heavy reactive objects upfront
consequence: Long tasks slow interaction or memory growth
current_protection: Vue/Vite production build and existing route lifecycle owners
minimum_prevention: Profile bundle and actual views; load required features only; paginate or virtualize measured large lists
discriminating_verification: Mobile/desktop production-artifact LCP INP CLS and interaction profile; no lab-to-field equivalence

affected_boundary: Model extraction retrieval and tool authority
trigger: Trust generated JSON citations or externally supplied instructions
consequence: False facts unsafe tool calls or cross-Business disclosure
current_protection: No operating AI path proven; current SQL authority remains separate
minimum_prevention: Typed tools with current rights and input/output checks; verify citations; user confirms proposed declarations
discriminating_verification: Arabic task evaluation plus injection forged evidence/tool scope revocation and provider failure cases

affected_boundary: AI cost data transfer and provider substitution
trigger: Fallback to another provider or retry without data/usage qualification
consequence: Privacy breach unexpected retention or multiplied cost
current_protection: Commercial HOLD and separate source/use rights
minimum_prevention: Qualify provider data policy and exact cost/time/token/retry budgets for task; no implicit training consent
discriminating_verification: Provider timeout retry usage and fallback denied when policy or budget is unknown

affected_boundary: Money units language calendars and time
trigger: Use float ambiguous local date or translated label as identity
consequence: Incorrect comparisons horizons and regional behavior
current_protection: Existing money/locale/current-intent responsibilities
minimum_prevention: Use exact monetary types currency stable identifiers explicit timezones and units; qualify Arabic text matching
discriminating_verification: Nonidentical currency/unit or DST boundary and same offering with Arabic variants; unknown distinct from zero

affected_boundary: Operational logs traces and admin metrics
trigger: Log tokens private payloads or unbounded tenant labels
consequence: Secret disclosure or monitoring-cardinality resource growth
current_protection: Existing internal administration authority boundary
minimum_prevention: Log operation status timing and safe identifiers with appropriate access; redact and bound metric labels
discriminating_verification: Failure path log inspection for secrets/private fields and admin/staff visibility negatives

trigger: Combine new feature with major runtime or framework replacement
consequence: Unattributable regressions and unsupported deployment assumptions
current_protection: Lockfiles and exact CI evidence; current supported major stack
minimum_prevention: Separate upgrade candidates; verify extensions drivers build SQL tests runtime contract and audit
discriminating_verification: Exact candidate lock/runtime manifest and applicable CI; Node26 compatibility candidate not automatic engine edit

trigger: Single-sector global rule or destructive rename/retirement
consequence: Wrong method for mixed business or changed historical interpretation
current_protection: Current versioned business_types and declarations
minimum_prevention: Reuse catalog owners; scope semantics to relevant offering/market/time; retire without erasing qualified history
discriminating_verification: Mixed product/service Business across markets; retired label preserved historically; unrelated methods remain stable

affected_boundary: Parallel worktrees and integrated contract revision
trigger: Independent tasks change shared SQL/API semantics against incompatible bases
consequence: Locally passing changes break combined consumers
current_protection: Existing Git worktrees PR evidence and contract owners
minimum_prevention: Record base shared files owner dependencies consumers and selected checks; reconcile semantics before integration
discriminating_verification: Test affected consumers on actual integrated revision and requalify evidence invalidated by base changes

affected_boundary: Cloud or other selected runtime compatibility
trigger: Assume supported lockfiles or generic cloud label prove deployability
consequence: Missing roles extensions workers recovery or unsuitable runtime configuration
current_protection: CI verifies isolated declared environment; actual selected runtime remains unverified
minimum_prevention: Derive runtime requirements from accepted architecture and compare suitable cloud/managed options without constraining design to existing hosting
discriminating_verification: Verify selected environment PHP/extensions DB roles transactions queue/scheduler callbacks secrets resource limits and restore before launch
